_device: object: The silicon as data with a data-sheet source: resource classes, memory primitives, shift registers, arithmetic blocks, the logic cell; no tool policy
_doc: hls-est configuration: the compiled-in defaults (device amd-xc7z020clg400-1, tool profile vitis-2025.1). Keys starting with _ are documentation and are ignored when this file is read back with --hls-config.
_frontend: object: What the MLIR input is assumed to look like
_plugins: object (free-form): plugins.<name>: a section owned by the plugin of that name, validated by it; a section whose plugin is not selected by any plugin key is refused
_run: object: Which device, which tool profile, which clock [S-17]
_scheduling: object: Operator timing, dependences, schedulers and binding [S-01..S-22]
_tool: object: The tool profile: what the HLS tool decides (hls), what the memory mapping back end decides (backend), the report and the default pipeline
_version: uint: Format version of the document; this hls-est reads 1

dependences._memory_recurrences: bool: A load and a store of one memory linked by a read-modify-write chain and a carried distance d bound the II of the pipelined loop: d = 1 (one element, or a[i-1]) or an address that cannot be computed: the chain's recurrence latency; d >= 2: ceil((2 + chain) / d) (VITIS_NOTES N87; off: no memory recurrence reaches the scheduler, OPEN_ISSUES O1) [S-11]
dependences._model: plugin name (a dependence_model): The DependenceModel (cached-o1 keeps OPEN_ISSUES O1) [S-11]
dependences._recurrence_latencies: map of int, cycles: Cycles an operator class adds to a memory recurrence chain (<class>_f32 / <class>_f64 are looked up before <class>); a class not listed adds its operator latency (VITIS_NOTES N83: fadd 4, dadd 5, fmul 3, dmul 6; integer add / multiply 0 measured, the II is at least 1) [S-11]

modulo._fast_ops_threshold: uint, ops: greedy-simplex: more operations than this go to the greedy scheduler (0: no rule) [S-08]
modulo._fast_threshold: uint, ops: greedy-simplex: more resource-limited operations than this go to the greedy scheduler (0: always) [S-08]
modulo._lower_ii_of_both: bool: greedy-simplex: a loop the simplex scheduler scheduled is also scheduled by the greedy scheduler, and the schedule with the lower II is kept (the simplex heuristic fixes the last store of an unrolled reduction before its loads, so a port- or bus-bound loop gets bumped far above its resource bound); a measured Vitis rule (kernels w9r13p_mx_r8: 8 reads on one m_axi bundle, Vitis II 8, simplex 14; w9r13p_nr_w16 / nr_w2 / nr_call: 16 reads on 2 ports, Vitis II 8, simplex 14; siddharth lab2 A x V loop, Vitis II 6, simplex 9; off: the simplex schedule stays) [S-08]
modulo._max_ii_bumps: uint: II increments the greedy scheduler tries [S-08, R-06]
modulo._max_pipeline_body_ops: uint, ops: A pipelined loop whose body has more operations is left sequential with a warning (a memory guard, designer knob; 0: none) [S-08]
modulo._recurrence_repair_rounds: uint: greedy scheduler: times a loop-carried edge broken by resource delays may move its destination later before the II is bumped (0: bump at once; 64 since R-cmpd is modelled, W9r7, OPEN_ISSUES O56); VITIS_NOTES N39 [S-08]
modulo._user_ii_target: bool: A loop with a user pipeline II=N > 1 is scheduled at N when it could start more often [P-14]

sequential._model: plugin name (a sequential_scheduler): The SequentialScheduler (none: the stretch-pair rule applies) [S-22]

timing._operator_latencies: map of int, cycles: Latency per operator class of calyx-fixed (unconfirmed against Vitis); call / kept_call -1: the loop stays sequential; the optional fpdiv_f32 / fpdiv_f64 / fpsqrt_f32 / fpsqrt_f64 replace fpdiv / fpsqrt for that element type (VITIS_NOTES N78); the optional stream_read / stream_write time a blocking hls::stream access on its stream's one port (N82; absent: the loop stays sequential) [S-01, S-03, S-04]

implicit_buffers._default_bundle: string: Bundle of a port without bundle= [A-03]
implicit_buffers._max_bus_bits: uint, bits: Widest adapter data width (AXI4 allows up to 1024 bits; a wider element takes several beats, VITIS_NOTES N56) [A-04]
implicit_buffers._min_bus_bits: uint, bits: Narrowest adapter data width [A-04]

bus_requests._read_per_cycle: uint: Read requests per cycle and bundle: a pipelined loop with n reads of the bundle's ports per iteration has II >= n / this; a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N95; kernels w9r13p_mx_r8: 8 reads, II 8; 0: unlimited)
bus_requests._write_per_cycle: uint: Write requests per cycle and bundle (VITIS_NOTES N95; kernels w9r13p_mx_w8 / mx_w4x2: 8 writes to one bundle, II 8; 4 to each of two, II 4; 0: unlimited)

read_fifo._cast_load_width: bool: The FIFO width counts loads through a pointer cast (reinterpret_cast<ap_uint<512>*>), else only the declared element; a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N56) [A-06]
read_fifo._confirmed_max_depth: uint, words: Deeper FIFOs are marked unconfirmed in the debug output (never changes a number) [A-06]
read_fifo._mapper: plugin name (a memory_mapper): The MemoryMapper that prices the FIFO, whatever the main mapper is [B-13]
read_fifo._per_channel: bool: One read FIFO per distinct channel= of the bundle's reading ports, else one per bundle; a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N56) [A-06]
read_fifo._power_of_two_width: bool: The read FIFO width (widest read access, at least the bus minimum) is rounded up to a power of two before the FIFO is priced, max_bus_bits applying after the rounding; a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N63) [A-06]
read_fifo._priced_config: string: The port configuration it is priced at [B-13]
read_fifo._srl_max_depth: uint, words: A read FIFO at most this deep is shift registers (0 BRAM); a measured Vitis rule [A-06]

write_buffer._confirmed_min_burst: uint, beats: Shorter priced bursts are marked unconfirmed (never changes a number) [A-07]
write_buffer._free_max_burst: uint, beats: A write burst at most this long needs no buffer RAM; a measured Vitis rule [A-07]
write_buffer._port_width_bits: uint, bits: Longer bursts cost ceil(bus width / this) [A-07]

inlining._honour_inline_off: bool: Calls to hls.inline_off callees stay calls (--inline-ignore-inline-off overrides) [P-01]

math_library._local_struct_tables_at_run_time: bool: A table filled from math calls of the loop index is evaluated at compile time when it is a plain local or a global (also through one-element register temporaries and per-bank stores), but computed at run time (a core) when it is a member memory of a local struct array (VITIS_NOTES N60); off: the stores are judged as before W9r7 [N-15]
math_library._table: string: Path of the math-core cost table (math_costs.json format; relative to the file that sets it); empty: math calls cost nothing (--bram-analysis=math-costs= overrides) [S-04, N-15]

memory_architecture._iteration_private_registers: bool: A local array, or a bank of a partitioned one, whose every access lies in the body of one loop L at one address that is an injective affine function of L's index and of values defined outside L (the same in every access, invariant in every loop nested in L), and whose first access in L's body is an unconditional store (every loop between L and it of constant trip count >= 1), holds only values one iteration of L writes and reads: it becomes registers, no memory (LLVM LICM promotion, store forwarding and dead-alloca removal in reflow; VITIS_NOTES N92, kernels w9r12p_rp_base, w9r12rv_n92_flat / n92_const2: Vitis no memory; rp_later / rp_nopart / w9r12rv_n92_varinit stay memories)
memory_architecture._one_loop_read_write_sdp: bool: A bank whose every access lies in one pipelined loop with one read and one write per cycle, or whose one read per iteration lies in one pipelined loop with at most II writes per iteration while every other loop only writes it, at most once per cycle, is bound to a read-only and a write-only port (RAM_S2P, simple dual port: x36 allowed); a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N90 (c), kernels w9r11i_gd_f / gd_h, w9r11rev_sdp_w / gd_pre / gd_post: RAM_AUTO_1R1W 512x32 = 1; with another loop reading the array it stays x18: gd_a / gd_b / gd_g = 2; off: RAM_2P, x18) [K-04, K-05]
memory_architecture._partitioned_argument_bank_ports: bool: A function argument with an array_partition pragma (its own, or that of a kept callee's parameter) has one port pool per bank in the scheduler: accesses whose bank is a constant never share a port with another bank's accesses, and an access whose bank is not a constant takes a port of every bank (VITIS_NOTES N88; kernels w9r11p_sa_r8 / sa_2d28 / sa_cpt, w9r11rev_pa_var3; off: one pool for the whole argument) [K-03]
memory_architecture._port_occupancy_cycles: uint, cycles: Cycles one access holds its port [K-11]
memory_architecture._port_set_rule: enum (by_kind|by_demand): Where a bank's port set comes from: the selected kind (by_kind), or the per-cycle demand (by_demand, a designer knob) [K-04, K-05, P-15]
memory_architecture._priced_configs: object: The port configurations whose max_width prices a bank [B-03, K-05]
memory_architecture._sequential_scope: object: Ports of a non-pipelined scope that no sequential scheduler scheduled [K-12..K-14]
memory_architecture._untracked_memory_ports: uint, ports: Ports of a memref the scheduler does not track (a function argument, a memref.alloc, a global) [K-03, K-20]
memory_architecture._wide_port_sets: array of port sets: Port sets priced at priced_configs.wide (Vitis' SDP test: one port, a read and a write port, two read ports) [K-05, N-10]

priced_configs._narrow: string: Configuration of any other bank and of every replicated copy [B-03]
priced_configs._wide: string: Configuration of a bank whose port set is wide [B-03]

replication._callee_stores_per_loop: bool: A bank passed to a callee whose loop body stores it twice is not replicable in the caller either [P-10]
replication._caller_stores_per_loop: bool: A callee's memref parameter is replicable for the callee's loops only when the arrays its call sites pass are: a caller loop (or another callee of that array) storing them more than once per iteration makes the parameter a 2-port memory for the scheduler too; a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N99; kernels w9r13p_nr_call / nr_call1: 16 caller stores per iteration, the callee's reader II 8; off: a callee parameter's replicability comes from the callee alone) [P-10]
replication._exclusive_arm_stores_once: bool: The stores the two arms of one if make count once per iteration, whatever their addresses (off: only a same-address pair) [P-10]
replication._max_copies: uint, copies: At most this many copies of a replicated bank (1: no replication); the scheduler's pool is max_copies * (ports - 1) + 1 slots [K-02]
replication._max_stores_per_iteration: uint, stores: A bank some loop body stores to more often than this is never replicated [K-06]
replication._port_bound_several_arrays: bool: A callee parameter whose call sites bind two or more different arrays is read through the module's own ports even with one instance: those arrays are never replicated for the callee's accesses (VITIS_NOTES N75; off: only a callee instantiated at more than one place) [K-02]
replication._port_bound_writable_globals: bool: A written global or function-static array is never replicated: its accesses, also those of a callee reading it through a parameter, go through its two ports and the loop II rises (VITIS_NOTES N85; off: such an array is replicated like a local) [K-02]
replication._shared_write_port_reads_when_idle: bool: The shared write port of the copies reads in a cycle without a write (the +1 slot) [K-02]

rom._copies: enum (ceil_half|n_minus_1): Copies of a ROM read more often (ROM_NP): ceil(n/2), or n-1 [K-08]
rom._sdp_max_reads: uint, reads/cycle: A ROM read at most this often per cycle is one simple-dual-port memory [K-08]
rom._sequential_state_reads: bool: In a sequential (non-pipelined) scope a ROM's reads issue as soon as their addresses are ready: the reads of one straight-line stretch at one dependence depth (the longest chain of reads of the stretch their address is computed from) share a state, and the ROM needs that many read ports (rom.copies copies above sdp_max_reads); a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N93, kernels w9r12p_rom_s2 / s3 / s4 / s8: 2 / 3 / 4 / 8 independent reads -> 1 / 2 / 2 / 4 ROM copies, rom_chain4: 1); off: two reads per state at most (N12) [K-08]

sequential_scope._model: enum (stretch-pair|one-port): stretch-pair: two independent accesses of one straight-line stretch share a state; one-port: one access per state [K-12]

middle_end._dse_guarded_stores: bool: GVN load PRE + DSE across an if: a store under an if of a pipelined loop body that a later store of the same address at the body's top level overwrites in the same iteration, with only loads of that address between (they take the guarded value through a select), uses no port; a measured Vitis rule (W9r11: stream_hls MultiHeadSelfAttention1 opt2 node2, init store + load + store of v17 at loop II 1) [L-02]
middle_end._forward_to_guarded_loads: bool: GVN store-to-load forwarding into an if: a load under an if of a pipelined loop body that reads the address a store at the body's top level wrote earlier in the same iteration (only loads of that address between) takes the stored value and uses no port (W9r11: class_ece8893 barry_walker lab2 output_matrix_local, 1 BRAM per bank) [L-02]
middle_end._globals: bool: The clean-ups of --convert-affine-to-loopschedule (invariant-load hoist, GVN of loads, store forwarding, DSE) treat a global array like a local one: its memref.get_global (one per function) is the root memref, and every call is a barrier for it; a measured Vitis rule (ECG_Classifier baseline conv1d_2b: the guarded read-modify-writes of a global accumulator merge to one per iteration, II 1; kernel ie_acc with the accumulator global; off: no access of a global is merged or forwarded) [L-02]
middle_end._gvn_conditional_loads: bool: GVN load PRE: loads of one address in one block and in the ifs nested in it, with no write of the memref between them, are one load per iteration; a measured Vitis rule (W9 round 8 review, kernels w9r8f_pr1 / pr2 / pr3) [L-02]
middle_end._gvn_loads: bool: GVN: a repeated load of one address is one load [L-02]
middle_end._licm_hoist_conditional: bool: Invariant loads nested in an if of the body are hoisted too (speculated) [P-11]
middle_end._licm_hoist_invariant_loads: bool: LICM: invariant loads move out of the pipelined loop and use none of its ports [L-01]
middle_end._licm_hoist_past_calls: bool: A memref some call takes is still hoisted from a loop without calls [P-11]
middle_end._merge_if_else_accesses: bool: A load / store both arms of an if/else make of one address is one access (SimplifyCFG / InstCombine) [P-11]
middle_end._store_forwarding: bool: Store-to-load forwarding and dead-store elimination within a block [L-03]

dead_memory._dead_calls: bool: A call of a kept callee whose written arrays are never read is deleted [P-12]
dead_memory._global_shared_by_functions_escapes: bool: A global used by more than one function escapes [E-02]
dead_memory._honour_preserve: bool: hls.preserve keeps a dead array (Vitis: no) [E-04]
dead_memory._load_store_cycles: bool: An array whose loads feed (as value, address or condition) stores into itself, directly or through other arrays, is kept: no cyclic dead-store elimination; a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N66)
dead_memory._overwritten_stores: bool: A store a later store of the same access overwrites before any read is deleted [E-03]

narrowing._complete_read_selector: bool: A read whose subscript of a completely partitioned dimension of S elements comes from an array's load demands ceil(log2 S) bits of it (the bank selector); a write's subscript demands every bit (VITIS_NOTES N91, kernels w9r12p_nw_*) [P-03]
narrowing._full_address_interface_modes: array of strings: Interface modes of a top-level array argument whose subscripts demand every bit (m_axi: 32 bits, VITIS_NOTES N41); an argument without a pragma or of another mode demands the bits of its own address like a local (ap_memory and s_axilite: confirmed, kernels w9p5_idx_mem256 and w9rv_n41_mc; the other modes unconfirmed) [P-03]
narrowing._load_demand: bool: Narrow to the low bits the loads' users demand [P-03]
narrowing._stored_ranges: bool: Narrow to the bits the stored values need [P-03]

options._pipeline_loops: uint, iterations: config_compile -pipeline_loops: a loop whose nested trip-count products are all <= this is pipelined and everything inside it unrolled; 0 disables the automatic decision [D-01]

array_partition._complete_threshold: uint, elements: Arrays of at most this many elements are completely partitioned (registers) [Q-02]
array_partition._include_ports: bool: Interface arrays are partitioned too [Q-09]
array_partition._throughput_driven: enum (auto|off): auto: port-pressure partitioning; off: only the automatic partitions (the ground truth); a bare --infer-vitis-split-array takes this value [Q-01]

partitioning._block_bank_from_loop_range: bool: A block-partitioned dimension whose index stays inside one block over the constant iteration range of its enclosing loops (buf[i + 64], i < 64, block depth 64) is accessed in that one bank, not through a store per candidate bank (VITIS_NOTES N86)
partitioning._compound_assign_two_stores: bool: An ap_fixed compound assignment (/=, *=, +=, -=; cgeist marks its store hls.ap_compound_assign) to a bank chosen at run time writes that bank twice: never RAM_1WNR, two writes per iteration (VITIS_NOTES N38 R-cmpd)
partitioning._constant_index: object: Rule (b): a dimension every access indexes with a constant [Q-03]
partitioning._policy: plugin name (a partition_policy): The PartitionPolicy [Q-03, Q-04, Q-08, Q-15]
partitioning._steer_affine_loads: bool: Unrolled copies of a partitioned load with distinct constant offsets read each bank once
partitioning._steer_window_groups: bool: Unrolled window reads (one runtime base plus constants on every partitioned dimension) read each bank once per member of a residue class: a steered group spans several partitioned dimensions, and copies that share a residue class form further groups (VITIS_NOTES N74; off: one dimension, distinct residues only)

constant_index._after_user_partition: bool: Rule (b) also applies to an array with a user cyclic / block array_partition, on every part (VITIS_NOTES N57) [Q-03]
constant_index._fold_division: bool: An index computed by division, remainder, shifts or bit operations on constants (an unrolled copy's `(k * 2) / 2`) is a constant for rules (b) / (c) and for memory banking, as LLVM's constant folding makes it before Vitis partitions; a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N97 (a); kernel w9r13p_st_row, siddharth lab2 `softmax_row`: a struct taken whole from a stream and read at the unrolled indices has no memory; off: only add / sub / mul fold) [Q-03]
constant_index._globals: bool: Rule (b) also applies to globals and function statics, over the accesses of every function (VITIS_NOTES N77) [Q-03]
constant_index._max_extent: uint, elements: Largest extent of such a dimension that is partitioned; a larger one stays whole (VITIS_NOTES N61; 0 or absent: no limit) [Q-03]
constant_index._min_extent: uint, elements: Smallest extent of such a dimension that is partitioned [Q-03]
constant_index._non_affine_arrays: bool: Rule (b) also applies to an array none of whose accesses is affine (VITIS_NOTES N57) [Q-03]
constant_index._pipo_streams: bool: Rule (b) also applies to an array whose only storage pragma is stream type=pipo (VITIS_NOTES N77) [Q-03]
constant_index._through_calls: bool: Rule (b) follows an array through the calls it is passed to (inline off callees, dataflow processes, recursively): the callee's accesses of the parameter count as the array's, so an array every function indexes with a constant in a dimension is partitioned there, and banking splits the callee's parameter the same way; a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N94; kernels w9r13p_ci_io / ci_wr / ci_df / ci_cyc, control ci_var; off: a call stops rule (b)) [Q-03]

inference._max_scanned_factor: uint: Factors above this are not scanned one by one (a guard) [Q-08]
inference._ports: object: Port model of the search, per bank and cycle [Q-06]
inference._rotating_banks: bool: A rotating access is charged to one bank (off: to every bank) [Q-08]
inference._target_ii: uint, cycles: II of a loop without its own [Q-07]

ports._any: uint, ports: Accesses of any kind [Q-06]

pipeline_decision._do_while_flatten_refusal: bool: A parent loop p is not flattened into its automatically pipelined child (no user pipeline) when the pipeline's complete unroll of a sub-loop of the child makes p + step a subscript of a multi-dimensional array that every iteration computes (no guard on the child's index, none false for that copy): Vitis' front end hoists the address, p becomes a do-while loop and Vitis refuses the flatten (200-960); the loops around p stay sequential too; a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N96; kernels w9r13p_dv_p1 / dv_p2 / dv_expl / dv_lin / dv_val, N76's n64_* kernels; off: flattened as any perfect parent)
pipeline_decision._do_while_min_subloop_trip: uint: do_while_flatten_refusal applies only to a subscript made by a sub-loop of at least this many iterations; a measured Vitis rule (kernels w9r13i_yp_d: a 2 x 2 window, flattened, against w9r13i_yp_c: 3 x 3, refused; Yolo-v3-tiny max_pool_2D_stride1, kernels w9r13i_yp_a / yp_b / yp_e / yp_f, flattened; the mechanism is unconfirmed)
pipeline_decision._flatten_across_calls: bool: Flatten a loop into a pipelined loop of a callee (documented assumption: never); reserved: only false is implemented, true is refused [D-11]
pipeline_decision._float_loads_perfect: bool: A read-only inner-invariant floating-point load keeps a nest perfect (flattened, not unrolled) [D-03]
pipeline_decision._fold_unrolled_guards: bool: After the unroll decisions, an if whose condition is false (or true) for every value once an unrolled copy's constant index is substituted loses its dead arm, so the accesses of that arm take no port and no schedule slot: an affine.if, or an scf.if whose condition is an affine comparison of loop variables (arith add / sub / constant multiply / rem / div, C's normalised %, and / or); in the then arm of an affine.if left, an operand an equality of its set fixes is that constant (an address it computes becomes invariant); a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N89; kernels w9r11p_sa_cnd2, w9r11rev_fg_mod / fg_unr; off: the copy's guarded accesses stay)
pipeline_decision._pipeline_off_sequential: bool: An innermost loop under `pipeline off` stays a sequential loop in --convert-affine-to-loopschedule (as a runtime-trip loop already did): its body is a state machine, so the sequential port model (VITIS_NOTES N12) and the ROM copies of one state (N93) apply, not a modulo schedule's replication; a measured Vitis rule (kernel w9r12rv_n93_loop: four independent ROM reads per iteration under pipeline off, Vitis 2 ROM copies; off: the loop is scheduled as a pipeline, 1)
pipeline_decision._policy: plugin name (a pipeline_policy): The PipelinePolicy [D-02, D-07, D-08]
pipeline_decision._promote_pipelined: bool: Promote the invariant accesses of the pipelined loop itself to registers after the unroll [D-06]
pipeline_decision._sink_parent_code: bool: The straight-line code (with memory accesses, no loops) before the child loop in the body of a loop flattened into a pipeline runs in the pipeline under a first-iteration guard, so its accesses count in the pipeline's port demand and schedule; a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N65)

streams._dataflow_argument_fifos: bool: A dataflow function forwards each scalar / m_axi pointer argument a later process reads through a FIFO <arg>_c, depth = processes on the longest channel path to the reader (+1 when the first process does not read it); priced as a stream FIFO (VITIS_NOTES N54) [P-06]
streams._declared_element_bits: bool: A FIFO is as wide as the packed C++ element cgeist records (hls.stream_element_bits: a struct is the sum of its members, bool 1 bit), else the IR type's packed bits (VITIS_NOTES N58) [P-06]
streams._default_depth: uint, words: Depth of a stream without a depth pragma or template argument [P-06]
streams._distinct_element_instances: bool: Calls of a kept function on distinct constant elements of an array of streams are concurrent: one instance each (VITIS_NOTES N59) [P-06]
streams._enabled: bool: Price the stream objects as FIFOs (--bram-stream-fifos overrides); off prices the handle storage as a RAM [P-06]
streams._mapper: plugin name (a memory_mapper): The MemoryMapper that prices a block-RAM FIFO [P-06]
streams._priced_config: string: The port configuration a FIFO is priced at (never x36) [P-06]
streams._srl_max_bits: uint, bits: FIFOs of at most this many bits (depth x width) are shift registers [P-06]
streams._srl_max_depth: uint, words: FIFOs at most this deep are shift registers at any width [P-06]
streams._stream_pragma_arrays: bool: A local array of a dataflow region with #pragma HLS stream (type fifo or none) and a depth is one FIFO of that depth at the element width, priced as a stream FIFO, instead of a memory; a measured Vitis rule (VITIS_NOTES N67)

structs._aggregate: bool: A variable an AGGREGATE pragma reached is one memory of packed words [P-02]
structs._element_copy_loops: bool: A loop that copies one whole struct element byte by byte (an inlined copy constructor / assignment, e.g. of an hls::vector) is one element copy, as Vitis turns the memcpy into one aggregate copy (VITIS_NOTES N44 / N51) [P-02]
structs._globals: bool: Struct-typed globals are split like locals [P-02]
structs._member_partitions: bool: An array_partition on a member path (variable=row.data) applies to the member's memory of a struct with one array member, its dim after the variable's dimensions (OPEN_ISSUES O78) [P-02]
structs._scalar_registers: bool: A member of a single struct variable accessed only at constant positions is registers [P-02]
structs._temporary_registers: bool: A one-element struct temporary cgeist materializes (a by-value operand, a returned struct) is split into registers, never a memory (VITIS_NOTES N51) [P-02]
structs._through_calls: bool: A variable passed whole to kept calls is split together with the callees' parameters [P-02]

timing_margin._fraction: number: Fraction of the period (Vitis default 27%) [S-20]

tool.name: vitis_hls

report._classes: array of strings: The classes printed and compared [N-07]
report._primary_memory_class: string: The class whose count is the bram= number [N-07]
report._reference_stage: enum (hls_estimate|post_synthesis|post_fit): Which ground-truth number the profile may be compared with [N-07]
report._stdout_format: enum (vitis-bram|per-class): vitis-bram: kind= / bram= lines and Total BRAM; per-class: also Total <class> for every class [N-07]
